integrity.proof_scope: all integers n>=1 and subsets S of {1,...,n}

scientific_limitations: Only one-step Catalan maps are covered; no global fiber maximum or all-Catalan distribution is claimed.
Older tableau-normal-form and full-core theorems are used as foundational results; the new element is enumeration and Stirling row stratification.
Computer verification is finite through n=8; the proof supplies the all-n result.
Unindexed earlier equivalent enumeration remains an originality risk.
title: Stirling–Bell fibers of one-step Catalan transformations
